title: Cute But Pretty Basic
text: Cute But Pretty Basic. This is a cute black collage style frame, but pretty basic. It is primarily a table top frame. There is one picture hanging hook on the back off one of the individual frames, but it would take 2 to hang properly. Plus the back that does have the picture frame also has the stand attached to it. The picture hanger is on the bottom (middle) of the frame and if you turned it around so you could utilize the hanger, then the stand part hangs down. I do plan to hang it up on the wall but I will use Command strips to do so. The frames are plastic and pretty sturdy. Two of the corners are not glued well and have a gap. It is a nice way to display a grouping of photos.
